rules.name: Canonical radical-SAM cysteine triad
rules.evidence_basis: Published shared structural/catalytic motif; not a discriminatory classifier
limitations: Shared by Cfr, RlmN and other radical-SAM proteins; cannot distinguish resistance function.
Noncanonical radical-SAM motifs exist; absence does not establish inactivity.
Domain and motif observations are correlated sequence evidence, not independent confirmations.
